<dl>
<dt>All Known Subinterfaces:</dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-linetilesource" title="interface in com.here.sdk.mapview.datasource">LineTileSource</a></code>, <code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-pointtilesource" title="interface in com.here.sdk.mapview.datasource">PointTileSource</a></code>, <code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-polygontilesource" title="interface in com.here.sdk.mapview.datasource">PolygonTileSource</a></code>, <code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-rastertilesource" title="interface in com.here.sdk.mapview.datasource">RasterTileSource</a></code></dd>

<hr>
<pre>public interface <span class="typeNameLabel">TileSource</span></pre>
<div class="block"><p>A source of tiles.
 The implementations must be thread-safe.
 <p>Note: This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected
 behavior. Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
</li>
</ul>
